analysis:
The Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana in Madhya Pradesh provides a monthly cash transfer to eligible women. It began at ₹1,000 per month in 2023, and Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan stated that the amount would be raised gradually to ₹3,000 per month.

Reported data show the transfer was increased to ₹1,250 during 2023 and then to ₹1,500 per month from November 2025, on a state Cabinet decision. The Bhaskar report records ₹1,587 crore transferred in the first ₹1,500 installment.

As of October 2026 the monthly amount remains ₹1,500, half of the stated ₹3,000 target, with no fixed deadline announced.
notes: The exact day of the ₹3,000 pledge is uncertain; it was announced during the 2023 scheme rollout and repeated through the November 2023 state election campaign, so the date is set to 2023-03-01 (day unknown) and the venue is general. Chouhan was Chief Minister until December 2023; the scheme has continued under Chief Minister Mohan Yadav. No specific deadline for reaching ₹3,000 was stated. The official portal URL (cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in) was seen referenced in search results (IMPPRI item) but was not fetched.
